faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear, honest information with no confusing agency jargon.

items.a: How much does a new customer bring you? If this brings in one or two a month, it has already paid for itself. And the setup fee is split into two halves.
That's why we handle everything. We only need photos and 20 minutes to review at the very end.

items.q: Clients come to me by word of mouth.
items.a: That's the best way. But when someone recommends you, the first thing they do is search for you on Google. If your profile is incomplete, they go to someone else.
No problem. We set up what your customers already use: direct phone calls, text messages, or 1-click booking.
That's why both the website and Google profile are completely bilingual in English and Spanish.

items.q: My nephew does that for me.
items.a: That's great. We leave the 1-page diagnosis for him to use. If he's ever too busy, we're right here.

items.q: Someone already sold me that and it didn't work.
items.a: We don't promise #1 spot on Google. We set up everything complete, send a monthly report, and the subscription cancels with 30 days notice.
That's why it's only 50%, with a signed legal contract and invoice. You pay the rest only after you approve.

ftc.title: Commitment to Honesty and Legal Compliance (FTC & TCPA)
ftc.text: Lumo HQ operates in strict compliance with the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) guidelines and the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA). We do not promise 'number one ranking on Google', we do not guarantee inflated customer counts, and we never sell, buy, or generate fake 5-star reviews. All customer reviews must originate from genuine experiences with real patrons. We do not engage in automated cold-calling or unsolicited bulk messaging.
